# E26 build plan

Planning evidence only. The frozen design is unchanged. Senior plan review precedes implementation.

## Build order and connections

The baseline has no `hub/`, `ui/` or `eval/`; `contracts/` and `config/` contain pharmacy artifacts only. E26 source, runtime documents, generated contracts and executable hub gates do not exist. `docs/requests/E26.md` is absent. The design review requests changes, and its response is evidence of proposed fixes, not a passing review (`docs/tdd/reviews/E26.astra-r1.md:1`, `docs/tdd/reviews/E26.response-r1.md:1`). No implementation gate was run.

| Task | Owns | Build order |
|---|---|---|
| T1 | The finite hub source inventory in design section 13, `hub/tests/help/`, the two E26 configuration documents | Tests, pure domain and agreed ports, SQLite/application, HTTP and real-stack acceptance |
| T2 | `ui/crew/src/features/help/`, `ui/crew/stryker.help.conf.json` | Component/property tests, local flow and reference journal, bootstrap consumer, screens |
| T3 | `ui/crew/e2e/help/` | After T1 and T2, real-browser acceptance against a running composed hub |

T1 and T2 can start independently against generated contracts and agreed ports. Keep T1 with one safety coder, as AGENTS section 5 requires. Do not split the state machine, its persistence and its guard among concurrent authors. T2 does not change Python ports. T3 changes tests only and reports defects to their owner. Each task's tests stay in its own paths. Ownership comes from `docs/tdd/E26.md:941`; all available other epic task inventories and design section 13 inventories were checked. No E26 intersection was found. Recheck at dispatch because plans are being added concurrently.

Hard prerequisites are E01, E02, E23 and E27-guidance (`docs/SYSTEM.md:2378`). E03/E20 provide shell/offline integration for browser acceptance; E21 provides the explicit demo fixture. Absent providers are tested through the published protocols and bounded `kernel.testing` fakes for component work only (`docs/SYSTEM.md:2388`). No production fake and no fake inside the hub in end to end tests. An unavailable prerequisite blocks its positive acceptance case.

The connection is E03's main-bundle HelpButton -> E26 localFlow and reference journal -> generated HTTP client -> E26 use cases -> E01 UoW, command identity, audit, outbox and replication. Fixed entry precedes authentication, storage and network. E20 owns document storage, verified emergency publication and queue encryption. E26 owns help content selection and replay. The hub owns accepted state. Optional assistant, roles and ground enrichment run outside care transactions. E11 alone owns urgency. E28 escalation follows SYSTEM 8.1's separate intent/help/plan commits, with a child help receipt, never a caller UoW.

## End to end evidence

T1 places HTTP acceptance in `hub/tests/help/`. T3 owns browser scenarios in `ui/crew/e2e/help/`. Both use E21's explicit `fixtures/demo-mara-fd19/`, normal `create_app(settings)`, real generated boundary validation/authentication and temporary real SQLite. Browser tests use the real shell and running hub. No route fulfillment, hub dependency overrides, mocked repositories, direct SQL clinical seeding or fake internal services. Documented fault controls may fail actual storage/process boundaries; optional external workers may be absent or use documented external fakes. Missing controls or providers fail acceptance, never skip it.

| Scenario and owner | Trace and proof |
|---|---|
| Fixed entry and dissimilar backups, T3; printed parity, T1 | R15/R39, V01/V97 help contribution, D15/D41; 001/002/100/103/104/105/110/112/113. Every registered route including sign-in, stopped model/devices/link, combined load: first paint within 500 ms without a network dependency. Remove hub and browser storage, then corrupt active/last-good/bootstrap; verified static entry or the printed procedure remains. No false saved state. |
| Air hazard, T3 | V60, D22; 070/073/074. Real E23/E24 warning precedes every question from any route; stale/offline snapshot labeled. Full V60 also proves exposed-person records, each person's E25 after-event checks and the exposed list delivered through E29. This is blocked on C5, not satisfied by warning order alone. |
| Triage and urgent entry, T1 plus T3 | V61/V62, D23; 012/013/017/018/019/072/090. Not responding and breathing not sure reach the configured emergency flow. Red-flag yes opens immediately; unknown stays unknown with help offered. A late client open joins E11's session without resetting it. Eye path, environment note and timed ticks match the pinned configuration. Full V61 requires real intake/E11. |
| Shared help and broadcast, T1 plus T3 | V71 and V62; 020/021/023/030/031. Two simultaneous pressers produce one session, both helpers, one log; leave/rejoin changes broadcast accurately. Second crew browser and station receive P0 only, no readings or clinical session event. Incapacitated/unknown subject never blocks fixed help. |
| Limited readings, T1 plus T3 | V64, D24; 040 to 046/087/097. Opener/current helper/subject read only the names/recent-reading projection; unrelated crew, ungranted officer, station and ground cannot read clinical state. Every successful summary read audited; leave/close/revocation ends access, including late responses and events. No journal/history/Observation grant. Future/late/partial/disagreeing and REPLAY inputs retain source/time and never look current by arrival. |
| Guarded assistance, T1 plus T3 | E26-02, V63, D25/D41; 050 to 059/071/102. Fixed steps render first with model stopped. Real E13 with documented external model stub accepts one configured question and rejects medicine/dose/unsupported or unavailable guidance in every field. Flow/close/epoch or grant change prevents late publication. Direct assistant safety mutations fail; no node, warning, urgency or broadcast change. |
| Approved ground log, T1 plus T3 | E26-04, R61, V62/V68, D26/D42; 060 to 069/075. Preview is read-only; only Tell the ground creates the immutable approved text/hash. Link down displays delay/contact; ticks continue after queueing. Long outage, restart and transport recovery preserve every approved tick from every visited flow, simulator attribution and canary exclusion. Duplicate/reordered receipts and two distinct replies are retained once, even after close. Ground cannot read before delivery. Real E29 transport/card and E16 delivery are required for full V68/D26. |
| Configuration and pinning, T1 plus T3 | R43, V75 help contribution; 010/011/080/081/085/086/088. Scratch step/broadcast text edit changes new sessions without code; existing hub/client sessions and pending journal entries retain old pins. Interrupted/corrupt activation preserves last good. Scan client content. Threshold/environment counterparts remain E01/E23/E24/E21 obligations. |
| Durability, replay and limits, T1 plus T3 | I-H12/I-H14/I-H16, EI1/EI2/EI5; 065/066/068/092 to 097/101/104/110 to 114. Kill before/after each command commit and before response; disk full, failed audit/outbox/commit, busy writer, quota/path/log caps, two clients, two offline flows and lost responses. Exact retry after 30 hours accepts once via D6 receipt; different target/parameters/body conflicts. Clock corrections and mission-day boundaries preserve sequence/pins; unknown time is visible. Guidance and human backups persist while unaccepted actions remain visibly pending. |

Numbers above abbreviate T-E26-NNN from `docs/tdd/E26.md:863`. T1 owns all original IDs except T2's 073/080/081/082/086/087/088/096/105/112 and T3's 070/071/074/095/100/104; T3 additionally exercises T2 component cases through the real UI. Every E26 work package, invariant and listed V/D has a collected scenario; partial contributions cannot pass a whole cross-epic scenario. E21 registers actual collected nodes, not guessed filenames. No extra eval directory is claimed by this plan.

Bind actor, operation, target, semantic parameters and body; mission-life shared receipts; reauthorize replay. 094 expects the authorized accepted_command receipt after the cache expires. |

## Requests

Addressed to the coordinator. These are handoffs for the absent `docs/requests/E26.md`, not canonically filed requests: this assignment permits edits only under `docs/build/E26/`. File them before dependent implementation, consolidating the design's R-E26-1 through R-E26-15 and Q-E26-1/2. Already binding SYSTEM/Part A decisions are not reopened. No task may resolve a missing shared mechanism locally.

| Handoff | Required action and acceptance hold |
|---|---|
| C1: ownership, assembly and storage | Authorize and supply the omitted help module.py, settings/architecture and replica.schema.json registration artifacts under SYSTEM 5.12/5.7.1/6.4. No task owns those omitted paths. Settle exact prefixed tables for design 5.1, SYSTEM help_action/help_broadcast/help_ground_message/help_log_snapshot and the incoming-event ledger, plus PlanHelpEntry's immutable receipt storage. Publish migration, ID, settings, local event audience, projection and task registrations. Canonical registration is required for composed HTTP acceptance; no app monkeypatch or migration runner. CLI print registration joins R-E20-3. |
| C2: typed provider and transaction seams | Consolidate E01 R-E01-17/27, E13 C2, E03 X-E03-29 and R-SYS-13/26. Publish snapshot/session/mission/origin/pin-aware observation and profile reads, TextRulesPort, bounded warning/role/ref readers, HelpSessionReader.context/readable_by and HelpLogSnapshots DTOs, E28 flow availability, and E13 start/cancel/guard/sink ownership. Keep domain DTOs pure with explicit application mapping. The existing detached FlowPlanSnapshot cannot prove current commit-time eligibility. Specify its trusted revision/recheck through the shared UoW and authoritative E13 display publication without nested transactions. Required privacy/assistant integration blocks until agreed; fixed entry stays independent. |
| C3: offline and shell | Settle R-E20-4/10 with E02/E03/E26: raw pinned bundle transport, E26 reference-journal access to E20 storage/crypto, owner/device/mission/origin identity, pre-auth capture/confirmation and retention, immutable replay dependencies and a schema-valid way to communicate replay truncation. Publish shell feature/slot/event cleanup signatures and main-bundle mounts, including sign-in. No new endpoint or shared TS type is invented here. Until agreed, reference-only unsent actions remain visibly unaccepted and fixed guidance works from the signed artifact; full offline durability acceptance remains blocked. |
| C4: ground projection | E29 design and code are absent. Bind canonical GroundLogComposer/GroundLinkQuery through E26-owned protocols, never import groundlink into help. Reconcile required GroundMessagePreview.ground_link with absent/unknown E29 without fabricating status/source/gap_planned; define a valid unavailable projection centrally. GroundMessage itself can retain the specified fallback. Bind transport/lifecycle event authentication, immutable approved catch_up facts and later complete delivery, with no implicit new clinical sharing. Retain replies internally and latest wire reply until R-E26-9 is accepted. Full V68/D26 and preview absence acceptance wait. |
| C5: product content and V60 | Apply R-E26-5/6/7 through the proper schema/content owners and regenerate examples for opener membership. Review state, Who/self route, air-safety instruction, readings/reconciliation words, log templates, citations and medicine vocabulary remain pending shapes. E03 owns ui-copy; E26 owns only the two granted runtime documents. Confirm real E24 alarm/exposure capture, E25 per-person after-event trigger and E29 exposed-person summary, including exact ports and test nodes. No accepted manual exposure mechanism is invented by this plan. Full V60 and configured instruction acceptance remain blocked. Visual-only help alerts remain the design interim; Q9 warning delivery is E24's responsibility. |
| C6: gates and evidence | E01/E03/E20 provide actual toolchain, shell, registration and bounded real-storage/process fault controls. E01's shared coverage/safety/trace/mutation validator currently specifies E01 inventory only; register E26's domain/application, complete condition/complexity inventory and test IDs before claiming its gates cover E26. E26 mutation minimum is 80 percent per listed safety file, with every survivor reviewed; Stryker includes localFlow/journal and E26 cache adapter, not E20's implementation. E21 registers collected HTTP/browser nodes and full V/D counterparts; E20 supplies CI/reference-machine runs. No zero collection, skipped positive case, unsupported tool option or E01-only report can pass E26. |
| C7: independent evidence and AI log | Coordinator records this planner run and future coder/reviewer runs in AI-USE-LOG.md, outside this edit scope. Senior plan review, resolved build review, local gates and green CI are required. Keep reference load measurements separate from hermetic tests. No clinical-validation or mission-acceptance claim follows from these gates. |

Task gates are future mandatory commands, copied from E26 section 15 and SYSTEM section 6 with owned targets. Shared checker registration and CLI compatibility are C6 prerequisites, not assumed executable today. After a bug fix rerun the full hub suite and owned UI suite. Final epic greenlight requires the union of all three task gates, whole V/D counterparts, reference measurements and independent review.
